operations.idempotency: exact replay returns the original command; same key with different semantics is rejected
operations.timeout: unknown outcome requires GET operation reconciliation before retry

operations.purpose: Reconcile a submitted command by immutable command identifier
operations.timeout: safe to retry with the same command identifier

operations.purpose: Claim a private automation run lease
operations.idempotency: one active lease per run and execution
terminal result is immutable for a run and execution

operations.purpose: Request reconciliation of an indeterminate automation outcome
operations.idempotency: same reconciliation request returns the original record
operations.timeout: retry reconciliation only; never repeat the external effect

operations.purpose: Report a classified failure for bounded retry or durable dead-letter handling
operations.idempotency: same job, execution, failure classification, and key returns the original transition
operations.timeout: read authoritative job state before any retry

operations.purpose: Request a durable human approval without granting authority to n8n
operations.idempotency: same approval request and key returns the original approval record
operations.timeout: read approval state before creating another request
